title: Abu Ubaidah's Trustworthiness
paragraphs: Dikenal luas karena integritasnya, Abu Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah pernah digambarkan sebagai orang yang terpercaya dari komunitas ini, gelar yang diberikan setelah ia secara konsisten mengelola sumber daya bersama dengan kejujuran penuh.

Selama sebuah ekspedisi sulit di mana persediaan makanan sangat terbatas, ia membagikan perbekalan yang tersisa secara adil di antara kelompok, tidak mengambil lebih untuk dirinya sendiri meski memegang posisi otoritas.

Para sahabat yang melakukan perjalanan bersamanya selama kesulitan sering menyebutkan bahwa keadilannya tidak pernah goyah, terlepas apakah ada yang mengawasi keputusannya atau memeriksa pembagian sumber dayanya.

Para pemimpin saat ini yang mempelajari teladannya sering mencatat bahwa kepercayaan, terutama selama kelangkaan, mengungkap karakter sejati seseorang lebih jelas daripada perilaku di masa kenyamanan dan kelimpahan.
answerKey: Known widely for his integrity, Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah was once described as the trustworthy one of this community, a title given after he consistently handled shared resources with complete honesty. During a difficult expedition where food supplies were extremely limited, he distributed the remaining provisions fairly among the group, taking no more for himself despite holding a position of authority. Companions who traveled with him during hardship often mentioned that his fairness never wavered, regardless of whether anyone was watching his decisions or checking his distribution of resources. Leaders today studying his example often note that trustworthiness, especially during scarcity, reveals a person's true character more clearly than behavior during times of comfort and abundance.
